parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/domain/entities module should contain only domain entities. Category.ts and Task.ts fit that role: both are immutable entity classes with their own isValid() invariants, and both are used by the repositories and use-cases. The other two files do not belong here. DateUtils.ts holds general date helpers (addDays, isWeekend, formatIsoDate, daysBetween). It has no entity and no domain invariant, and no Task or Category behavior uses it. NotificationFormatter.ts handles how outgoing e-mail and SMS messages are formatted: the 160-character SMS limit, e-mail headers, a signature line, and HTML escaping. That is a presentation or delivery concern, not an entity concern. Nothing in the incoming edges uses either file. So the module is split into unrelated concerns, which fails the rubric. I found no duplicated invariant and no bypassed abstraction between Task and Category.

violations.message: General-purpose date helpers (addDays, isWeekend, formatIsoDate, daysBetween) are not domain entities. This unrelated utility concern belongs in a separate shared or utility module, not in the entities module.
